Job Description: Junior Full Stack Developer Intern
Company: TechNova Solutions
Location: Remote / Hybrid
About the Role:
TechNova Solutions is seeking a motivated Junior Full Stack Developer Intern to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will work on building scalable web applications, designing RESTful APIs, and developing responsive user interfaces.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain front-end web interfaces and back-end services.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate REST APIs and microservices.
Write clean, testable code and maintain codebases using Git and GitHub.
Optimize application performance, manage local/cloud database schemas, and debug production issues.
Required Technical Skills:
Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL
Frameworks & Libraries: Node.js, Express, React, Pandas
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, Linux, Docker
Database Management: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
Qualifications & Requirements:
Basic understanding of data structures, algorithms, and web development fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with version control workflows using GitHub.
Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn modern full-stack frameworks.
